Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: (1) A 1.5-kw single-phase converter operates at full load from a 230-volt a-c source. Neglecting losses, and assuming a power factor of unity, calculate: (a) the d-c voltage and current; (b) the a-c input current. (2) A 2.5-kw single-phase converter is operated inverted, i.e., it converts direct to alternating current. If the d-c input voltage is 230, calculate: (a) the a-c voltage; (b) the alternating and direct currents at full load.

Options: 
A. 1(a) d-c voltage = 320 volts, d-c current = 4.5 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 6 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 160 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 15 amp, direct current = 10 amp
B. 1(a) d-c voltage = 340 volts, d-c current = 4.41 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 6.6 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 190 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 13.16 amp, direct current = 8.77 amp
C. 1(a) d-c voltage = 315 volts, d-c current = 4.76 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 6.45 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 210 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 11.9 amp, direct current = 7.93 amp
D. 1(a) d-c voltage = 310 volts, d-c current = 4.84 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 6.5 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 200 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 12.5 amp, direct current = 8.3 amp
E. 1(a) d-c voltage = 360 volts, d-c current = 4.17 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 5.2 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 180 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 13.89 amp, direct current = 9.26 amp
F. 1(a) d-c voltage = 350 volts, d-c current = 3.5 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 5.5 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 170 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 16 amp, direct current = 11 amp
G. 1(a) d-c voltage = 325 volts, d-c current = 4.62 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 6.25 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 162.5 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 15.4 amp, direct current = 10.9 amp
H. 1(a) d-c voltage = 300 volts, d-c current = 5 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 7 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 150 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 14 amp, direct current = 9 amp
I. 1(a) d-c voltage = 295 volts, d-c current = 5.08 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 7.5 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 140 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 17.86 amp, direct current = 11.9 amp
J. 1(a) d-c voltage = 330 volts, d-c current = 4.55 amp; 1(b) a-c input current = 6.35 amp; 2(a) a-c voltage = 220 volts; 2(b) alternating current = 11.36 amp, direct current = 7.58 amp

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
